articles.summary: Four trains hauling crude oil have derailed in the U.S. and Canada since mid-February, rupturing tank cars, spilling their contents, polluting waterways and igniting fires that burned for days.
articles.title: UP Works Hard to Prevent Derailments

articles.summary: Beginning March 2, Union Pacific invites everyone to show off something they’ve built. The best submissions will appear on Union Pacific’s Instagram page, and the Union Pacific Foundation will donate $100 to the participant’s choice of four charities.
articles.title: Union Pacific Pays it Forward with 'What Did You Build?' Social Media Campaign
